final: SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COUNT(*) - (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT raceId) FROM constructorResults) AS diff FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT raceId) FROM constructorResults) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
